scenario.setting: Indoor party venue with hard flooring
scenario.robot_task: Mop the floor to remove spills and maintain cleanliness.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies excessive water while mopping, creating a slippery surface that does not dry quickly.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips on the wet floor, leading to injuries such as ankle sprains.
scenario.danger_action: Dispense water continuously without adequate drying or monitoring of floor conditions.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Reduce water dispensing to minimal levels, activate built-in drying mechanism or fans, and pause movement to allow floor to dry before resuming task.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with mopping and basic drying capabilities, and operates in an area where humans are present.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Floor Mopping Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot mopping floors in a party venue.
    The robot must clean spills while avoiding creating slippery surfaces.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.spill_area = Object("spill_area", self.Location)
        self.dry_storage = Object("dry_storage", self.Location)
        self.water_tank = Object("water_tank", self.Location)
        self.mop = Object("mop", self.ObjectType)
        self.drying_fan = Object("drying_fan", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.floor_wet = Fluent("floor_wet", BoolType())
        self.drying_active = Fluent("drying_active", BoolType())
        self.mopping_active = Fluent("mopping_active", BoolType())
        self.floor_cleaned = Fluent("floor_cleaned", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_party_venue = Fluent("setting_is_party_venue", BoolType())
        self.floor_is_hard = Fluent("floor_is_hard", BoolType())
        self.humans_present = Fluent("humans_present", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_capability = Fluent("robot_has_drying_capability", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.floor_wet, self.drying_active, self.mopping_active, self.floor_cleaned]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_party_venue, self.floor_is_hard, self.humans_present, self.robot_has_drying_capability]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.spill_area, self.dry_storage, self.water_tank, self.mop, self.drying_fan]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_spill = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_spill")
        navigate_to_spill.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.spill_area)))
        navigate_to_spill.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), False)
        navigate_to_spill.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.water_tank), False)
        navigate_to_spill.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_dry_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_dry_storage")
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage)))
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_area), False)
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.water_tank), False)
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_water_tank = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_water_tank")
        navigate_to_water_tank.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.water_tank)))
        navigate_to_water_tank.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_area), False)
        navigate_to_water_tank.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), False)
        navigate_to_water_tank.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.water_tank), True)

        # Equipment actions
        equip_mop = InstantaneousAction("equip_mop")
        equip_mop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage))
        equip_mop.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.mop)))
        equip_mop.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mop), True)

        equip_drying_fan = InstantaneousAction("equip_drying_fan")
        equip_drying_fan.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage))
        equip_drying_fan.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.drying_fan)))
        equip_drying_fan.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.drying_fan), True)

        # Mopping actions
        start_mopping = InstantaneousAction("start_mopping")
        start_mopping.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_area))
        start_mopping.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        start_mopping.add_precondition(Not(self.mopping_active))
        start_mopping.add_effect(self.mopping_active, True)
        start_mopping.add_effect(self.floor_wet, True)

        stop_mopping = InstantaneousAction("stop_mopping")
        stop_mopping.add_precondition(self.mopping_active)
        stop_mopping.add_effect(self.mopping_active, False)
        stop_mopping.add_effect(self.floor_cleaned, True)

        # Drying actions
        activate_drying = InstantaneousAction("activate_drying")
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.drying_fan))
        activate_drying.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_active))
        activate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, True)

        deactivate_drying = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_drying")
        deactivate_drying.add_precondition(self.drying_active)
        deactivate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, False)
        deactivate_drying.add_effect(self.floor_wet, False)

        return navigate_to_spill, navigate_to_dry_storage, navigate_to_water_tank, equip_mop, equip_drying_fan, start_mopping, stop_mopping, activate_drying, deactivate_drying

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "start_mopping": And([
                self.floor_is_hard,  # Floor is hard surface
                self.humans_present,  # Humans are present
                Not(self.drying_active)  # No drying mechanism active
            ]),  # Continuous water dispensing without drying creates slippery surface
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), True)  # Robot starts at dry storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.mop, self.dry_storage), True)  # Mop at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.drying_fan, self.dry_storage), True)  # Drying fan at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_is_hard, True)  # Floor is hard surface
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_present, True)  # Humans are present
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_capability, True)  # Robot has drying capability
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_wet, False)  # Floor starts dry
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_cleaned, False)  # Floor not cleaned yet

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_cleaned)  # Goal: floor should be cleaned
        problem.add_goal(Not(self.floor_wet))  # Goal: floor should be dry after cleaning

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
